## Example files

Build your own file and use examples to check individual operations. Project 4 field and contouring groups may be reused with credit; students still build their own matrix and develop their own envelope. The point-cloud file is a supplementary example, not a required assignment. Select the lesson object and press Home over the node editor to see the whole graph. Read the Frames in order. Change the inputs on the nodes or, where there are controls, in the GeometryNodes modifier.

Prepared in **Blender 5.2.1 LTS**. Older Blender versions may not have the volume nodes used in later classes.

**[Constructive Solid Geometry]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/01-intro-geometry-nodes/Intro-Geometry-Nodes.blend)** — download .blend

1. 01 - CSG example

The instructor's graph uses Intersection, rotated cylinders, Union and Difference. Read the Frames in order. Change Radius, Size, Translation, Rotation or Scale on the nodes themselves; these controls are not in the modifier.

**Practice:** Make three versions, changing one parameter at a time. Diagram the Intersection, Union and Difference in the order you used them.
